seo_title: Custom CAE Software: B2B Supplier Compliance & Onboarding
seo_desc: Are expiring compliance documents a mess in your SME? We develop custom databases to automate your B2B supplier onboarding and safety compliance.
author_pitch: As a Database Architect, I find it legally irresponsible for industrial or construction companies to control their subcontractors' health and safety documentation and insurance with an Excel spreadsheet. If an external worker has an accident and their insurance expired yesterday, your company faces millionaire lawsuits. I build custom portals and databases that automate supplier compliance, physically blocking access to your facilities if a single paper is missing.
title: The legal Russian roulette: Custom Software Development for Contractor Compliance
body:
Is your administrative department terrified that a subcontractor might enter your facilities to work with expired liability insurance or safety training?

In sectors like construction, logistics, or manufacturing, Contractor Compliance (CAE) is a bureaucratic nightmare. You have dozens of suppliers and hundreds of external workers entering your factories or construction sites. Controlling that every worker has an up-to-date medical check, valid ISO certificates, and paid payrolls using shared folders and spreadsheets is impossible. A single administrative oversight exposes you to site shutdowns and extremely severe criminal fines.

The trap of Third-Party Compliance Platforms

To try and protect themselves, many SMEs hire standard cloud compliance platforms. These SaaS tools charge exorbitant monthly fees based on the number of uploaded documents and force your suppliers to learn how to use complex interfaces, causing delays and bottlenecks in your projects. Delegating your company's legal security to a generic software that charges for every PDF you upload is suffocating your own supply chain.

Our solution: Custom Compliance Database

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we build your own regulatory compliance ecosystem. As software architects, we develop a relational database and a supplier portal that you own, adapted to your specific legal requirements and without per-user licenses.

  1. Relational Expiration Engine: We structure a smart database that links the supplier company, its workers, and its machinery, calculating and auditing the validity of each document in real time.
  2. Zero-Friction Upload Portal: We program an ultra-light external web interface where your suppliers simply drag and drop their PDFs, featuring a traffic light system that tells them which documents are urgent.
  3. OCR Validation and Automatic Alerts: The system reads document expiration dates and sends automatic email reminders to the subcontractor thirty days before an insurance policy expires.
  4. Access Control Integration: We connect the compliance database with physical turnstiles or security guards' applications, technically denying entry to any worker with pending paperwork.

The Real Impact on your Company's Security

  • Legal Risk Reduced to Zero: Because an automated technical block exists, it is mathematically impossible for an external worker to operate in your facilities without being one hundred percent compliant.
  • Elimination of Administrative Bottlenecks: Your safety team stops chasing suppliers over the phone demanding paperwork, saving dozens of hours a week in manual tasks.
  • Data Ownership and No Monthly Fees: Because it is a custom system, your SME is the sole owner of your collaborators' sensitive information, scaling to thousands of documents without paying a single cent more in monthly licenses.
